name: workbuddy-bridge
description: Use selectable WorkBuddy models as native workers through a local Responses-to-ACP adapter, with optional bounded parent-side delegation through the WorkBuddy Bridge MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Orchestrate bounded WorkBuddy workers with native subagent
interface.longDescription: A model-selectable native WorkBuddy worker integration that translates Codex Responses requests to WorkBuddy ACP/CLI, plus a versioned, persistent, auditable, approval-gated parent-side WorkBuddy Bridge MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Delegate a bounded plan or confirmed scoped edit to a selected WorkBuddy worker.
Use the native subagent path for one-shot WorkBuddy tasks.
Run a confirmed scoped edit through WorkBuddy and verify the evidence.
